title: Polymathy
summary: POLYM'ATHY, noun [Gr.many, and learning; to learn.] The knowledge of many arts and sciences; acquaintance with many branches of learning or with various subjects.

inlines.v: POLYM'ATHY, noun [Gr.many, and learning; to learn.] The knowledge of many arts and sciences; acquaintance with many branches of learning or with various subjects.
